  [Data](https://sharefulton.fultoncountyga.gov/resource/9ggd-zyxa.json) | [Docs](https://dev.socrata.com/foundry/sharefulton.fultoncountyga.gov/9ggd-zyxa) | Last update: Apr 2024  
  This dataset contains a monthly record of how many defendants are in jail on Superior Court Criminal cases. It counts each defendant in jail once, using the dataset https://sharefulton.fultoncountyga.gov/Government/Superior-Court-Defendants-in-Jail/raqb-js7j. This data contains the current days count, as well as one datapoint from the last day of each previous month, starting 2019-01-01.

- **Separations Public Dataset**  
  [Data](https://sharefulton.fultoncountyga.gov/resource/pvp8-8nav.json) | [Docs](https://dev.socrata.com/foundry/sharefulton.fultoncountyga.gov/pvp8-8nav) | Last update: Jul 2024  
  This dataset contains a record of all employee separations, as well as the date, reason, position information, and salary information at time of separation.

- **Sheriff App: Meals and Portable Bunks**  
  [Data](https://sharefulton.fultoncountyga.gov/resource/hewq-yaft.json) | [Docs](https://dev.socrata.com/foundry/sharefulton.fultoncountyga.gov/hewq-yaft) | Last update: Jul 2024  
  This dataset shows the number of meals served per day at the jail and the number of inmates on portable punks per day. This data is collected via a webform, and the FCSO is responsible for entering data into that webform. This dataset is updated daily from data in that webform.

- **Superior Court Case Assignments**  
  [Data](https://sharefulton.fultoncountyga.gov/resource/e8ne-c2s2.json) | [Docs](https://dev.socrata.com/foundry/sharefulton.fultoncountyga.gov/e8ne-c2s2) | Last update: Jul 2024  
  Information provided on each case includes the case number, case type (e.g., non-complex felony, capital felony), the date filed, the date assigned, the judge assigned, the current status (e.g. open, closed), and flags indicating whether the defendant is in jail and whether the assignment is current (or the last assignment in the case of closed cases).

- **Superior Court Dashboard: Update History**  
  [Data](https://sharefulton.fultoncountyga.gov/resource/iwcz-fkim.json) | [Docs](https://dev.socrata.com/foundry/sharefulton.fultoncountyga.gov/iwcz-fkim) | Last update: Jul 2024  
  This contains a short log of when the data behind the Superior Court dashboards was last extracted from Odyssey. This is not the same as the date that those datasets were last updated on Socrata, as they are independent processes.

- **Superior Court: Current Pending Cases**  
  [Data](https://sharefulton.fultoncountyga.gov/resource/u8gi-zru8.json) | [Docs](https://dev.socrata.com/foundry/sharefulton.fultoncountyga.gov/u8gi-zru8) | Last update: Jul 2024  
  This dataset contains all currently pending Superior Court cases. This includes all criminal complex, criminal non-complex, family, civil, and business cases. This data is extracted daily from the Odyssey system, and also updated here daily.

- **TSPLOST Project Locations**  
  [Data](https://sharefulton.fultoncountyga.gov/resource/bcjt-asar.json) | [Docs](https://dev.socrata.com/foundry/sharefulton.fultoncountyga.gov/bcjt-asar) | Last update: Jan 2023  
  This dataset contains the point locations of transportation projects in Fulton County (outside the City of Atlanta) that are funded through TSPLOST.
